Support and Continuous Improvement Act as a technical escalation point for support issues, diagnosing and resolving problems in live client environments. Produce clear technical documentation, including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and client-specific configuration records. Feed client learnings back to Product and Engineering to improve deployment tooling, standards, and the Submarine platform. Mentor colleagues and promote DevOps best practices across the Implementation team. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Working understanding of JavaScript and how the components fit together. Excellent troubleshooting skills across networking, messaging (e.g., RabbitMQ), and file transfer (e.g., SFTP) components. Understanding of security best practices and compliance frameworks, and experience working within enterprise security reviews. Excellent written and verbal communication, including producing detailed technical documentation and runbooks. Preferred Experience in financial services or market data environments (we will consider exceptional candidates without this). Basic understanding of financial instruments (e.g. futures, bonds, equities) to support day-to-day client conversations. Familiarity with market data systems (Market EDM, Golden Source, Cadence/Cadis, or CRD from State Street). API integration experience (REST APIs, data requests, response handling). Knowledge of GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux), policy-as-code (OPA, Kyverno), and Docker image pipelines and artifact repositories. Experience supporting a production service, including on-call or support rotas. Soft Skills Confident presenter who builds credibility quickly with client technical teams. Comfortable working asynchronously and collaborating across Sales, Engineering, Support, and clients (Slack, Teams). Genuine ownership of their work and their clients: sees things through to the end, and treats problems, including incidents, as theirs to solve. Understands the context behind a client request and distils it into clear next steps, without needing a detailed ticket. Judges the level of effort involved and spots and flags scope creep early. Manages their own deadlines without close supervision. Stays organised across a large amount of scattered information, through memory or their own system, so nothing is dropped. This matters even more during incident response. Spots potential issues early and suggests improvements without being prompted. Ability to evaluate trade-offs and make pragmatic recommendations when client environments differ from our standard. Working With Us You will work closely with business analysts, engineering teams, Sales, and Support, deepening your understanding of market data systems as you go.
